_arm_configs: Four combinations: {xArm6, xArm850} x {original, gripper2} mounting. cam and gripper are parented to the arm FLANGE, so calibration depends only on the mounting, never on the arm model. Same mounting => identical cam/gripper frames across models; scripts/check-fragments.py enforces that. THE TWO MOUNTINGS DIFFER BY 180 DEGREES ABOUT THE TOOL AXIS. The gripper sits ON that axis at t=(0,0,150), so the rotation moves it 0mm - its position is identical under both mountings and only its orientation changes, which is exactly the cue you cannot judge by eye. The camera is 83mm off-axis, so it moves 168mm. Decide the mounting on CAMERA POSITION via scripts/identify-config.py; never infer it from how the gripper looks.

xarm6-original.name: ufactory-xarm6-realsense
xarm6-original.note: cam t=(83,-14,18). Mounting is decided by CAMERA POSITION - the gripper cannot tell you, see _arm_configs

xarm6-gripper2.name: xarm-realsense-gripper2
xarm6-gripper2.note: cam t=(-83,14,18), gripper th=180. Mounting is decided by CAMERA POSITION - the gripper cannot tell you, see _arm_configs

xarm850-original.name: xarm850-realsense-original
xarm850-original.note: xArm850. cam t=(83,-14,18). Mounting is decided by CAMERA POSITION - the gripper cannot tell you, see _arm_configs

xarm850-gripper2.name: xarm850-realsense-gripper2
xarm850-gripper2.note: xArm850. cam t=(-83,14,18), gripper th=180. Mounting is decided by CAMERA POSITION - the gripper cannot tell you, see _arm_configs

arm._controller_ip_note: DEFAULT ONLY - the controller address differs from machine to machine. uFactory ships .212 but they get reassigned. Confirm each arm and pass --arm-ip; provision-viam.py validates it is on the arm subnet and not the host address.

workcell_defaults._comment: Box CENTERS, not faces. face = center +/- size/2. See docs/geometry.md
